description: He wears an opaque dark green wool knee-length tunic with long sleeves and tan-gold knotwork borders at the neck, front, cuffs and hem. Cream linen cuffs show at his wrists. A heavy dark green checked wool cloak with knotwork edging and fringe drapes across the shoulders and fastens at one shoulder with a large round bronze-toned brooch. A broad brown leather belt has a round knotwork buckle, circular fittings and a hanging end. Brown trousers, brown leg wraps and brown leather ankle shoes complete the outfit. No headgear or weapon is visible.
